meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: Claude 为 HyperFrames 合成做画面运动时会先确定运动主体和可见状态,再用 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等写出可安全定位的键帧,并用 hyperframes 命令验证。它只负责画面运动,剪辑和音频交给其他技能。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推近/拉远、缩放、摄像机移动等画面运动,或用 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等做键帧,或运行 hyperframes keyframes 诊断时触发。

say.text: 给这个合成加一个从全景推到人物面部的放大关键帧
say.note: 会按此技能编写缩放键帧并验证。

say.text: 用 GSAP 让这个元素向右平移再回原位,做两个关键帧
say.note: 生成一个暂停的 GSAP 时间线并注册到 window。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes keyframes 诊断,检查当前合成的键帧

howto.what_en: Claude authors seek-safe keyframes for HyperFrames motion: names the subject, defines visible states, writes GSAP/CSS/Anime.js keyframes, and verifies via hyperframes commands. Visual motion only; clip/audio handled elsewhere.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in/out, zoom, camera moves, or when using GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, etc., or when running hyperframes keyframes diagnostics.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in keyframe zooming from a wide shot to the subject's face.
say_en.note: Writes and verifies a zoom keyframe.

say_en.text: Use GSAP to move this element right then back with two keyframes.
say_en.note: Creates a paused GSAP timeline and registers it.

say_en.text: Run 'hyperframes keyframes' diagnostics to check the composition's keyframes.
